comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a damper; record sorts four cubes while yielding both arms during timed human reaches into a shared bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-tool manipulation, counterholding, fine rotational adjustment, locking, and guarded cycle actuation. Record requires pick-and-place plus temporal monitoring, withdrawal, and dual-arm human-distance compliance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate passes after two safe repeatable carriage stops and a post-lock drift test. Record passes when all cubes rest on matching mats without either gripper entering the bin or approaching within 10 cm of the hand during its reach.
comparison.reason: Human-aware shared-space yielding is a meaningfully different tested ability from force-limited adjustment and dynamic damper tuning. The record does not specify cube-release/stillness or a numeric drop threshold; candidate leaves several tuning tolerances undeclared, but neither omission suggests overlap.
